title: Operations Tools — User Manual
summary: Overview of the eight Showground Operational Tools: IT Projects, RSS Feed, Knowledge Base, Bookings, Saved Queries, Scheduling, Licenses, and Bulk & Reports.

sections.body:
Overview

Operations Tools ("Showground Operational Tools") bundles eight day-to-day operational utilities behind one page: IT Projects, Live RSS Feed, Knowledge Base, Asset Bookings, Saved Queries, Resource Scheduling, Software Licenses, and Bulk & Reports.

What Each Tab Does

  • IT Projects — a Kanban board for IT project tasks.
  • Live RSS Feed — an aggregated feed of relevant external updates.
  • Knowledge Base — lightweight internal articles (for quick notes; longer manuals/SOPs belong in Docs & SOPs instead).
  • Asset Bookings — reserve an asset for a future date/time window.
  • Saved Queries — save and re-run frequently used asset/ticket filters.
  • Resource Scheduling — plan resource or staff allocation.
  • Software Licenses — track license seats and expiry dates.
  • Bulk & Reports — bulk-update asset status, bulk CSV import, generate CSV/PDF reports, and see what's due for maintenance.

Tips

  • If you're writing a formal procedure or reference manual (like this one), it belongs in Docs & SOPs, not the Knowledge Base tab here — the Knowledge Base is for quick, informal notes.
